notes.content:

[h1]REAVE | Devlog 25 is OUT NOW![/h1]  
The [b]September Playtest is LIVE right now[/b] — gear up and face the Scarth Tyrant today.  

Join the Discord to get access -> [url=https://discord.gg/Reave style=button]Reave Discord[/url]  

[h2]💀 Tyrant Troubles ⚔️[/h2]  
[quote][*] 👑 [b]Meet the Scarth Tyrant[/b] — REAVE’s first true boss encounter  
[*] 🎨 [b]From Concept to Reality[/b] — watch the Tyrant take shape from art to 3D model to in-game terror  
[*] 💥 [b]Devastating Abilities[/b] — uncover its brutal attacks and overwhelming power[/quote]  
📢 The latest [b]Reave Devlog[/b] has arrived, revealing the [b]Scarth Tyrant[/b] for the very first time.  
This towering force of power and intimidation marks a new era of challenge in REAVE.  

⚡ [b]The September Playtest is LIVE — jump in and face the Tyrant today![/b] ⚡  
⏳ [i]September Playtest ends on September 30th[/i] ⏳  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652815/0963675fcc92918032bdc5a621155cc8300be774.gif[/img]

👉 [b]Watch the Devlog and meet the Tyrant… then join the playtest and meet him in person![/b] 🥳✨

notes.title: REAVE | Iron Shadows Playtest is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1][b]REAVE | Playtest 10: Iron Shadows is LIVE 🎉[/b][/h1]
Join the Discord to get access -> [url=https://discord.gg/Reave style=button]Reave Discord[/url]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652815/2755923e0965630933808e2495ba76d3d8912f01.gif[/img]

The playtest runs from [b]September 18th to September 30th[/b].

❗ [b]Please update your game to the latest version before playing![/b]

[b]What’s New in This Playtest:[/b]

• 🏅 [b]Claim your legend[/b] – unlock 30+ titles with the new [b]Names & Title System[/b]  
• 🥷 [b]Strike from the shadows[/b] – equip the all-new [b]Rogue Armor Set[/b], the first Light Armor for agile fighters  
• 🏰 [b]Explore new territory[/b] – discover the atmospheric [b]Iron Keep[/b], the final of the four new spawn areas  
• ⚔️ [b]Command the Hall[/b] – venture into the re-imagined [b]Command Hall[/b], an upgraded take on the old Guard’s Lair  
• 🎥 [b]Capture the action[/b] – record your raids and antics with the new [b]LIV Camera[/b], with flexible FOVs, resolutions and aspect ratios  
• ⚖️ [b]Balance & loot updates[/b] – rarity-based stamina scaling, merchant pricing tweaks and rebalanced weapon & armor stats

[b]🏆 Community Bounty[/b]  
Summon and defeat a boss while recording your run—use any software or the new [b]LIV Camera[/b]—and your clip could be featured in the next YouTube Devlog!

📰 Full patch notes will be posted on the official wiki: https://reave.wiki.gg/wiki/September_2025_Changelist
[url=https://reave.wiki.gg style=button]Reave Wiki[/url]

Join the Discord to playtest, chat with the devs, and help shape the future of REAVE!  
[url=https://discord.gg/Reave style=button]Reave Discord[/url]
